environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALBv2 in a private subnet (no IGW). The ALB has an AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING action override set to COUNT (not BLOCK), (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in default BLOCK mode, and (3) a custom rule group with a single RegexPatternSet rule matching request URI path '/api/users/search' that inspects SingleQueryArgument 'value' against pattern `(?i)(?:'|--|;|union\s|select\s|insert\s|drop\s|update\s|exec\s|xp_)` with action BLOCK and priority 0. CloudWatch metric namespace 'WAF/SQLiBlocks' publishes match counts. The ALB access logs are shipped to S3 with a lifecycle policy.

config.network: private subnet, no IGW, NAT gateway for egress only
config.security_group_inbound: ALB SG only (no direct public access to tasks)
